disclaimer: This is a curated starting reference, not an exhaustive compatibility database. Verify upstream release notes before production upgrades.

records.name: Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1
records.summary: Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.5 and later require Java 21. This record is a baseline runtime reference, not a guarantee that every mod or server plugin is compatible.

records.name: Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.4
records.summary: Java 17 is the common runtime baseline for this generation of Minecraft Java Edition. Check the exact server distribution and mod-loader requirements before choosing a runtime.

records.name: Minecraft Java Edition 1.19.2
records.summary: Java 17 is the typical runtime for this version family. Mod compatibility depends on the exact loader and mod build; this record does not certify individual mods.

records.name: Fabric
records.java: Follow the selected Minecraft version's runtime requirement
records.summary: Fabric Loader and Fabric API are separate components. Confirm both the loader and each mod support the exact game version; do not infer compatibility from the loader alone.

records.name: Minecraft Forge
records.java: Follow the selected Minecraft version and Forge build requirements
records.summary: Forge builds are tied to Minecraft versions. Verify the exact Forge build and each mod's supported game version before changing a server.

records.name: Paper
records.java: Follow Paper's requirements for the exact build
records.summary: Paper is not a drop-in guarantee for every Bukkit/Spigot plugin. Check the target Paper build and plugin documentation, especially for version-sensitive APIs.

records.name: Vanilla dedicated server
records.java: Follow the matching Minecraft server release requirement
records.summary: Use the server jar and Java runtime appropriate to the exact release. Back up worlds and configuration before updating.
